key_insight: A semi-analytical method constructs propagating dipolar vortices, or modons, in vertically sheared flows with arbitrarily many quasi-geostrophic fluid layers.
engineering_relevance: The method supports idealized modeling of coherent ocean vortices that can transport fluid over long distances.
method: Represent stratified flow using an N-layer quasi-geostrophic framework.
Construct modon solutions semi-analytically in a vertically sheared background flow.
Examine interlayer differences and depth-dependent potential-vorticity gradients.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports three example modons illustrating effects of interlayer variation and potential-vorticity gradients associated with surface deformation and velocity shear.
watch_item: The abstract does not report observational validation or stability testing of the constructed solutions.
paper_title: N-Layer quasi-geostrophic modons in a vertically sheared flow
